patthana23.48:1.1: Nasanidassanasappaṭighaṃ naācayagāmiṃ dhammaṃ paccayā anidassanaappaṭigho ācayagāmī dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā… hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana23.48:2.1: Nasanidassanasappaṭighaṃ naapacayagāmiṃ dhammaṃ paccayā anidassanaappaṭigho apacayagāmī dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā… hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana23.48:3.1: Nasanidassanasappaṭighaṃ nanevācayagāmināpacayagāmiṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca sanidassanasappaṭigho nevācayagāmināpacayagāmī dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā… hetuyā ekavīsa.
